children: FedEx completed offerings of €2.0 billion and $1.1 billion in notes, issuing euro notes due 2030/2034 and a USD note due 2036.
Issued €1,100,000,000 of 4.000% notes due 2030 and €900,000,000 of 4.625% notes due 2034 via Euro Notes Offering.
Issued $1,100,000,000 of 5.750% notes due 2036 via USD Notes Offering.
Underwriting agreements executed with multiple international and U.S. banks; offerings consummated on September 14, 2026.
Exhibits from the offering filing are being incorporated by reference into the Company’s Form S-3 registration statement.
